newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela utilized industrial capacity rises.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela utilized industrial capacity rises.

text.p: Utilized capacity in Venezuela's industrial sector rose to 62.7 percent in the second quarter from 58.5 percent in the same period last year, according to an industrial survey published in local newspapers Tuesday.

The survey of 450 companies, carried out by industrial group Conindustria and local pollsters Datanalisis, showed utilized capacity was up from 60 percent in the first quarter but down from 65.1 percent in the 1996 fourth quarter.
On employment, the survey showed that in the second quarter 20.2 percent of industrial companies had increased their payrolls, 55.8 percent had maintained them, and 24 percent had reduced them.
According to government figures, the Venezuelan economy grew by 2.8 percent in the first half and is projected to grow by four percent over the year as a whole.
